title: Terrain
description: Wardley maps as views of one shared landscape: a component is one record on every map, and dated assessments set where it stands. Draw and drag on SVG paper with draft and commit, write the map as OnlineWardleyMaps text both ways, check it with a validator, and export SVG, PNG and text.
